description: Real NEAR MPC responses (v1.signer-prod.testnet 3.18.0) replayed by contracts/mock-mpc in the sandbox tests: the master public keys and the CKD output of the IBE spike. Every entry names the NEAR transaction or view it was read from; docs/verification.md has the commands. Signatures are produced by the mock's test keys, never replayed for another message.

ckd.source: docs/verification.md, CKD and IBE section: round 1 of the IBE spike contract
